answer: Identity aging with proof-of-work forces each agent to burn compute on a time-locked puzzle whose difficulty ramps as the identity matures, so a fresh sybil starts on the frozen tundra of near-zero trust and must spend real cycles to climb toward the velvet plateau of verified standing. Reaching the trusted zenith requires sustained, auditable work that costs an attacker linearly in hardware and energy per fake identity, making mass forgery economically ruinous while honest agents amortize the same cost across genuine output.
